_comment: Strict enforcement. Adds a model and effort floor and prevents hooks being disabled. Read the cost table in README.md before deploying this instead of the baseline.
_comment_hooks: false here means a user cannot set it to true. It affects every plugin's hooks, not only wizrelay's.
_comment_model: A floor, not a target. routing still proposes a stronger model per task; this only stops a session dropping below it. `effortLevel` does not accept `max`.
